Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh…
I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown…
He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me…
Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow…
But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

translations.web: Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they spoke to Pharaoh.
